question: As per census 2011, what is the position of Maharashtra with respect to the total population in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Second.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Maharashtra is the second most populous state in India as per the census of 2011.
 
• It has a population of over 112 million people.
 
• The state covers an area of 307,713 square kilometers and has a population density of 365 people per square kilometer.
 
• Maharashtra is home to some of the most populous cities in India, including Mumbai, Pune, and Nagpur.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, and West Bengal** are the top three states in terms of population.
 
• Uttar Pradesh is the most populous state in India with a population of over **200 million people.**
